paragraphs: Rabbi Burki before Mana; he objected before him, Jerusalem Kiddushin, Ha'omer. Yitzchak ben Elazar called Burki and Yehoshua son of Tima a holy congregation, Kohelet Midrash, “See life”; Jerusalem Avodah Zarah, Kol Hatzelamim, see there. In Yochanan’s name, Jerusalem Yoma, end of chapter 5.
